note: Whether each bibliography entry has a DOI, and where a null came from. An empty doi field cannot distinguish 'no DOI exists' from 'nobody looked', and those are different states in the same way quotes_declined distinguishes a figure we chose not to quote from one we never saw. Every entry here was resolved on 2026-08-25.
method: Crossref query.bibliographic per title, then the candidate DOI resolved and its registered title compared with ours. A high similarity score was not sufficient on its own: the first trial query returned a book chapter on sampling heterogeneous materials for a paper about file-system error handling, and one candidate at 0.85 similarity turned out to belong to a different paper whose title differs by one word.
rule: Every entry in refs.bib either carries a doi field or appears here with a reason. Enforced by tests/evaluation/test_paper_citations.py.
